frameworks.name: CIS Amazon Web Services Foundations Benchmark v1.4.0

requirements.name: Maintain current contact details
requirements.reason: Contacts presence and distinct name, phone, and email counts are API-visible; whether those details are current and reach more than one actual person requires owner confirmation. Existing signal: Primary, billing, operations and security contacts are all registered and distinct (reads Partition, Contacts, collection_status, absent).

requirements.name: Ensure multi-factor authentication (MFA) is enabled for all IAM users that have a console password
requirements.reason: The requirement demands Ensure multi-factor authentication (MFA) is enabled for all IAM users that have a console password. The existing evaluator tests Console users have MFA configured (reads LoginProfile, MFADevices, absent, items).

requirements.name: Do not setup access keys during initial user setup for all IAM users that have a console password
requirements.reason: The requirement demands Do not setup access keys during initial user setup for all IAM users that have a console password. The existing evaluator tests Console users have no never-used active access key (Prowler) (reads password_enabled, true).

requirements.name: Ensure credentials unused for 45 days or greater are disabled
requirements.reason: The requirement demands Ensure credentials unused for 45 days or greater are disabled. The existing evaluator tests Active access keys were used within 45 days (Prowler) (reads access_key_1_active, access_key_2_active, true); Console password was used within the last 45 days (Prowler) (evaluator prowler_console_45).

requirements.name: Ensure there is only one active access key available for any single IAM user
requirements.reason: The requirement demands Ensure there is only one active access key available for any single IAM user. The existing evaluator tests Principal does not have two active access keys (Prowler) (reads access_key_1_active, access_key_2_active).

requirements.name: Ensure access keys are rotated every 90 days or less
requirements.reason: The requirement demands Ensure access keys are rotated every 90 days or less. The existing evaluator tests Active access keys were rotated within 90 days (Prowler) (reads access_key_1_last_rotated, access_key_2_last_rotated, true).

requirements.name: Ensure IAM Users Receive Permissions Only Through Groups
requirements.reason: The requirement demands Ensure IAM Users Receive Permissions Only Through Groups. The existing evaluator tests IAM user has no direct inline or managed policies (reads AttachedManagedPolicies, UserPolicyList).

requirements.name: Ensure IAM policies that allow full "*:*" administrative privileges are not attached
requirements.reason: The requirement demands Ensure IAM policies that allow full "*:*" administrative privileges are not attached. The existing evaluator tests Attached AWS managed policy does not grant administrative access (Prowler) (evaluator evaluate); Attached customer managed policy does not grant administrative access (Prowler) (evaluator evaluate).

requirements.name: Ensure a support role has been created to manage incidents with AWS Support
requirements.reason: The requirement demands Ensure a support role has been created to manage incidents with AWS Support. The existing evaluator tests A role with AWSSupportAccess exists (Prowler) (reads RoleName).

requirements.name: Ensure IAM instance roles are used for AWS resource access from instances
requirements.reason: An attached instance profile is observable, but the evaluator cannot establish that workloads use its temporary role credentials instead of embedded or external credentials.

requirements.name: Ensure that all the expired SSL/TLS certificates stored in AWS IAM are removed
requirements.reason: The requirement demands Ensure that all the expired SSL/TLS certificates stored in AWS IAM are removed. The existing evaluator tests IAM server certificate is not expired at the captured time (Prowler) (reads Expiration).

requirements.name: Ensure security contact information is registered
requirements.reason: SecurityContact.NamePresent from the Account Management contact inventory establishes alternate security contact registration. Evaluated checks: AWS account has a security alternate contact registered (reads Partition, SecurityContact, collection_status, absent).

requirements.name: Ensure that IAM Access analyzer is enabled for all regions
requirements.reason: All declared analyzer statuses are checked, but analyzer type and external-access coverage are not established.

requirements.name: Ensure IAM users are managed centrally via identity federation or AWS Organizations for multi-account environments
requirements.reason: SAML provider existence is a partial federation signal; whether IAM users actually authenticate via central identity requires owner or identity activity evidence.

requirements.name: Ensure security questions are registered in the AWS account
requirements.reason: AWS does not expose account support security questions through a read-only API, so registration requires account-owner attestation.

requirements.name: Ensure no 'root' user account access key exists
requirements.reason: The requirement demands Ensure no 'root' user account access key exists. The existing evaluator tests Root account has no access keys (evaluator aws_iam_no_root_keys).

requirements.name: Ensure MFA is enabled for the 'root' user account
requirements.reason: The requirement demands Ensure MFA is enabled for the 'root' user account. The existing evaluator tests Root credentials have MFA configured (reads user, password_enabled, mfa_active).

requirements.name: Ensure hardware MFA is enabled for the 'root' user account
requirements.reason: The requirement demands Ensure hardware MFA is enabled for the 'root' user account. The existing evaluator tests Root user with credentials uses hardware MFA (Prowler) (reads arn, true, User, Arn).

requirements.name: Eliminate use of the 'root' user for administrative and daily tasks
requirements.reason: Recent root inactivity is a partial signal; administrator practice and longer-term root use require owner review.

requirements.name: Ensure IAM password policy requires minimum length of 14 or greater
requirements.reason: The requirement demands Ensure IAM password policy requires minimum length of 14 or greater. The existing evaluator tests IAM password policy requires at least 14 characters (evaluator aws_iam_password_minimum_length).

requirements.name: Ensure IAM password policy prevents password reuse
requirements.reason: The requirement demands Ensure IAM password policy prevents password reuse. The existing evaluator tests IAM password policy prevents reuse of exactly 24 prior passwords (evaluator aws_iam_password_reuse_prevention).

requirements.name: Ensure all S3 buckets employ encryption-at-rest
requirements.reason: The requirement demands Ensure all S3 buckets employ encryption-at-rest. The existing evaluator tests S3 bucket has native default encryption configuration (reads Encryption, collection_status, absent).

requirements.name: Ensure S3 Bucket Policy is set to deny HTTP requests
requirements.reason: The requirement demands Ensure S3 Bucket Policy is set to deny HTTP requests. The existing evaluator tests S3 bucket policy denies every request made without TLS (reads Name, Sid, Policy, Statement).

requirements.name: Ensure MFA Delete is enabled on S3 buckets
requirements.reason: The requirement demands Ensure MFA Delete is enabled on S3 buckets. The existing evaluator tests S3 bucket has MFA Delete enabled (reads Versioning, collection_status, MFADelete).

requirements.name: Ensure all data in Amazon S3 has been discovered, classified and secured when required.
requirements.reason: Macie enabled/automated discovery and the existing bucketDefinitions job check are partial signals. BucketCriteria job membership and completed classification must be checked; securing findings requires owner evidence.

new_checks.data_source: s3:ListAllMyBuckets Buckets[].Name; macie2:GetMacieSession status; macie2:GetAutomatedDiscoveryConfiguration status; macie2:ListClassificationJobs jobId; macie2:DescribeClassificationJob status, s3JobDefinition.bucketDefinitions[].accountId,buckets[] and bucketCriteria.includes/excludes
new_checks.predicate: For every inventoried bucket, FAIL if automated discovery status is not ENABLED and no classification job with status RUNNING or COMPLETE selects that bucket via bucketDefinitions or bucketCriteria includes minus excludes; UNKNOWN if any selection rule or job status cannot be resolved. Findings remediation remains manual.
new_checks.title: S3 buckets have verifiable Macie discovery coverage
new_checks.description: Detects a S3 bucket whose S3 ARN lacks active Macie discovery coverage; unclassified S3 data may remain undiscovered and unprotected.
new_checks.remediation_hint: Enable Macie automated discovery or create a RUNNING classification job whose bucket selection includes each scoped S3 bucket.

requirements.name: Ensure that S3 Buckets are configured with 'Block public access (bucket settings)'
requirements.reason: The evaluator checks IgnorePublicAcls and RestrictPublicBuckets, but does not establish BlockPublicAcls and BlockPublicPolicy for each bucket. Those two Block Public Access settings remain untested.

requirements.name: Ensure EBS Volume Encryption is Enabled in all Regions
requirements.reason: The requirement demands Ensure EBS Volume Encryption is Enabled in all Regions. The existing evaluator tests EBS volume encryption is enabled (evaluator aws_ebs_encryption).

requirements.name: Ensure that encryption is enabled for RDS Instances
requirements.reason: RDS instance storage encryption is tested by aws.rds.encryption; TLS parameters are unrelated.

requirements.name: Ensure CloudTrail is enabled in all regions
requirements.reason: The requirement demands Ensure CloudTrail is enabled in all regions. The existing evaluator tests Every region is covered by a logging CloudTrail trail (reads HomeRegion, IsMultiRegionTrail, TrailARN, cloudtrail).

requirements.name: Ensure that Object-level logging for write events is enabled for S3 bucket
requirements.reason: The requirement demands Ensure that Object-level logging for write events is enabled for S3 bucket. The existing evaluator tests A logging trail records S3 object-level write data events for all buckets (evaluator evaluate).

requirements.name: Ensure that Object-level logging for read events is enabled for S3 bucket
requirements.reason: The requirement demands Ensure that Object-level logging for read events is enabled for S3 bucket. The existing evaluator tests A logging trail records S3 object-level read data events for all buckets (evaluator evaluate).

requirements.name: Ensure CloudTrail log file validation is enabled
requirements.reason: The requirement demands Ensure CloudTrail log file validation is enabled. The existing evaluator tests CloudTrail log file validation is enabled (evaluator aws_cloudtrail_log_validation).

requirements.name: Ensure the S3 bucket used to store CloudTrail logs is not publicly accessible
requirements.reason: The joined CloudTrail bucket check examines source-declared public ACL and policy grants; it does not prove effective public access after all policy conditions, access points, and account controls are evaluated.

requirements.name: Ensure CloudTrail trails are integrated with CloudWatch Logs
requirements.reason: The requirement demands Ensure CloudTrail trails are integrated with CloudWatch Logs. The existing evaluator tests CloudTrail has delivered to CloudWatch within the captured prior 24 hours (reads Name, Status, collection_status, LatestCloudWatchLogsDeliveryTime).

requirements.name: Ensure AWS Config is enabled in all regions
requirements.reason: The requirement demands Ensure AWS Config is enabled in all regions. The existing evaluator tests An AWS Config recorder is recording without a reported failure in the selected region (reads name, recording, lastStatus, config_recorder).

requirements.name: Ensure S3 bucket access logging is enabled on the CloudTrail S3 bucket
requirements.reason: The requirement demands Ensure S3 bucket access logging is enabled on the CloudTrail S3 bucket. The existing evaluator tests Named CloudTrail trail's in-scope bucket has server access logging (reads Name, Logging, collection_status).

requirements.name: Ensure CloudTrail logs are encrypted at rest using KMS CMKs
requirements.reason: The requirement demands Ensure CloudTrail logs are encrypted at rest using KMS CMKs. The existing evaluator tests CloudTrail trail declares KMS encryption (evaluator aws_cloudtrail_kms_encryption).

requirements.name: Ensure rotation for customer created symmetric CMKs is enabled
requirements.reason: The requirement demands Ensure rotation for customer created symmetric CMKs is enabled. The existing evaluator tests Enabled symmetric customer managed KMS key has rotation enabled (Prowler) (evaluator prowler_rotation).

requirements.name: Ensure VPC flow logging is enabled in all VPCs
requirements.reason: The evaluator covers only VPCs classified as in use. It does not establish flow logging on every other VPC required by this control.

requirements.name: Ensure a log metric filter and alarm exist for unauthorized API calls
requirements.reason: The requirement demands Ensure a log metric filter and alarm exist for unauthorized API calls. The existing evaluator tests A CloudWatch metric filter and alarm detect unauthorized API calls (reads id).

requirements.name: Ensure a log metric filter and alarm exist for security group changes
requirements.reason: The requirement demands Ensure a log metric filter and alarm exist for security group changes. The existing evaluator tests A CloudWatch metric filter and alarm detect security group changes (reads id).

requirements.name: Ensure a log metric filter and alarm exist for changes to Network Access Control Lists (NACL)
requirements.reason: The requirement demands Ensure a log metric filter and alarm exist for changes to Network Access Control Lists (NACL). The existing evaluator tests A CloudWatch metric filter and alarm detect network ACL changes (reads id).

requirements.name: Ensure a log metric filter and alarm exist for changes to network gateways
requirements.reason: The requirement demands Ensure a log metric filter and alarm exist for changes to network gateways. The existing evaluator tests A CloudWatch metric filter and alarm detect network gateway changes (reads id).

requirements.reason: The requirement demands Ensure a log metric filter and alarm exist for route table changes. The existing evaluator tests A CloudWatch metric filter and alarm detect route table changes (reads id).

requirements.reason: The requirement demands Ensure a log metric filter and alarm exist for VPC changes. The existing evaluator tests A CloudWatch metric filter and alarm detect VPC changes (reads id).

requirements.reason: The requirement demands Ensure a log metric filter and alarm exists for AWS Organizations changes. The existing evaluator tests A CloudWatch metric filter and alarm detect AWS Organizations changes (reads id).

requirements.name: Ensure a log metric filter and alarm exist for Management Console sign-in without MFA
requirements.reason: The requirement demands Ensure a log metric filter and alarm exist for Management Console sign-in without MFA. The existing evaluator tests A CloudWatch metric filter and alarm detect Management Console sign-in without MFA (reads id).

requirements.name: Ensure a log metric filter and alarm exist for usage of 'root' account
requirements.reason: The requirement demands Ensure a log metric filter and alarm exist for usage of 'root' account. The existing evaluator tests A CloudWatch metric filter and alarm detect root account usage (reads id).

requirements.name: Ensure a log metric filter and alarm exist for IAM policy changes
requirements.reason: The requirement demands Ensure a log metric filter and alarm exist for IAM policy changes. The existing evaluator tests A CloudWatch metric filter and alarm detect IAM policy changes (reads id).

requirements.name: Ensure a log metric filter and alarm exist for CloudTrail configuration changes
requirements.reason: The requirement demands Ensure a log metric filter and alarm exist for CloudTrail configuration changes. The existing evaluator tests A CloudWatch metric filter and alarm detect CloudTrail configuration changes (reads id).

requirements.name: Ensure a log metric filter and alarm exist for AWS Management Console authentication failures
requirements.reason: The requirement demands Ensure a log metric filter and alarm exist for AWS Management Console authentication failures. The existing evaluator tests A CloudWatch metric filter and alarm detect Management Console authentication failures (reads id).

requirements.name: Ensure a log metric filter and alarm exist for disabling or scheduled deletion of customer created CMKs
requirements.reason: The requirement demands Ensure a log metric filter and alarm exist for disabling or scheduled deletion of customer created CMKs. The existing evaluator tests A CloudWatch metric filter and alarm detect disabling or scheduled deletion of customer managed KMS keys (reads id).

requirements.name: Ensure a log metric filter and alarm exist for S3 bucket policy changes
requirements.reason: The requirement demands Ensure a log metric filter and alarm exist for S3 bucket policy changes. The existing evaluator tests A CloudWatch metric filter and alarm detect S3 bucket policy changes (reads id).

requirements.name: Ensure a log metric filter and alarm exist for AWS Config configuration changes
requirements.reason: The requirement demands Ensure a log metric filter and alarm exist for AWS Config configuration changes. The existing evaluator tests A CloudWatch metric filter and alarm detect AWS Config configuration changes (reads id).

requirements.name: Ensure no Network ACLs allow ingress from 0.0.0.0/0 to remote server administration ports
requirements.reason: The requirement demands Ensure no Network ACLs allow ingress from 0.0.0.0/0 to remote server administration ports. The existing evaluator tests Network ACL does not allow all ingress from 0.0.0.0/0 or ::/0 (reads Entries, GroupName); Network ACL does not allow TCP 22 ingress from 0.0.0.0/0 or ::/0 (reads Entries, GroupName); Network ACL does not allow TCP 3389 ingress from 0.0.0.0/0 or ::/0 (reads Entries, GroupName).

requirements.name: Ensure no security groups allow ingress from 0.0.0.0/0 to remote server administration ports
requirements.reason: The native SSH/RDP evaluators inspect only in-use security groups. Unattached security groups can still permit world ingress to remote-administration ports and remain outside this evidence.

requirements.name: Ensure the default security group of every VPC restricts all traffic
requirements.reason: Every VPC default group must have no inbound or outbound rules, including unused groups.

requirements.name: Ensure routing tables for VPC peering are "least access"
requirements.reason: The requirement demands Ensure routing tables for VPC peering are "least access". The existing evaluator tests Peering route tables do not route 0.0.0.0/0 or the requester CIDR over peering (reads VpcPeeringConnectionId, RequesterVpcInfo, Routes, Origin).

new_checks.data_source: s3:ListAllMyBuckets Buckets[].Name; macie2:GetMacieSession status; macie2:GetAutomatedDiscoveryConfiguration status; macie2:ListClassificationJobs jobId; macie2:DescribeClassificationJob status, s3JobDefinition.bucketDefinitions[].accountId,buckets[] and bucketCriteria.includes/excludes
new_checks.predicate: For every inventoried bucket, FAIL if automated discovery status is not ENABLED and no classification job with status RUNNING or COMPLETE selects that bucket via bucketDefinitions or bucketCriteria includes minus excludes; UNKNOWN if any selection rule or job status cannot be resolved. requirements.name: 6.4 Ensure that HTTPS is enabled on load balancer
requirements.reason: No existing native evaluator tests this resource-specific setting; the specified read-only fields can establish the configuration.

new_checks.data_source: elasticbeanstalk:DescribeEnvironmentResources EnvironmentResources.LoadBalancers[].Name; elbv2:DescribeListeners Listeners[].Protocol,Certificates,DefaultActions; elasticloadbalancing:DescribeLoadBalancers ListenerDescriptions[].Listener.LoadBalancerPort,Protocol,SSLCertificateId
new_checks.predicate: FAIL if a Beanstalk-associated load balancer has no HTTPS/TLS listener with a nonempty certificate ARN/ID, or has a plaintext listener without an HTTPS redirect action; UNKNOWN if listener or association inventory is missing.
new_checks.title: Elastic Beanstalk load balancers serve HTTPS
new_checks.description: Detects an Elastic Beanstalk environment whose Beanstalk load balancer has an HTTP-only listener; this weakens request protection, change control or forensic visibility at the application edge.
new_checks.remediation_hint: Attach a valid certificate to an HTTPS listener and redirect HTTP.

requirements.name: 2.1.3 Ensure all data in Amazon S3 has been discovered, classified, and secured when necessary
requirements.reason: Macie enabled/automated discovery and the existing bucketDefinitions job check are partial signals. BucketCriteria job membership and completed classification must be checked; securing findings requires owner evidence.

new_checks.data_source: s3:ListAllMyBuckets Buckets[].Name; macie2:GetMacieSession status; macie2:GetAutomatedDiscoveryConfiguration status; macie2:ListClassificationJobs jobId; macie2:DescribeClassificationJob status, s3JobDefinition.bucketDefinitions[].accountId,buckets[] and bucketCriteria.includes/excludes
new_checks.predicate: For every inventoried bucket, FAIL if automated discovery status is not ENABLED and no classification job with status RUNNING or COMPLETE selects that bucket via bucketDefinitions or bucketCriteria includes minus excludes; UNKNOWN if any selection rule or job status cannot be resolved. requirements.name: Backup plan min frequency and min retention check
requirements.reason: Same pinned Steampipe control in every benchmark. Its text (AWS Config backup-plan-min-frequency-and-min-retention-check) requires at least one rule meeting frequency and 35-day retention: aws_nist_backup_plan_min_retention_35_days with an operator-declared frequency (UNKNOWN without it). The pinned query is retention-only per rule, kept as aws.c2b.backup.plan_rules_retention_35; neither alone completes the row, so it stays PARTIAL.
evidence: steampipe-mod-aws-compliance@803dda1f conformance_pack/backup.pp:31-34 control text; :158-182 retention-only query

new_checks.data_source: existing collected backup_plan GetBackupPlan detail: Plan.BackupPlan.Rules[].ScheduleExpression, ScheduleExpressionTimezone, EnableContinuousBackup and Lifecycle; plus the operator-declared, scope-bound required_frequency_hours sealed in snapshot metadata.compliance_policy.aws_backup_plan (operator policy input, not an observed cloud fact; never defaulted)
new_checks.predicate: Per collected backup plan in its audited account/Region: PASS when at least one rule has a cron schedule on a fixed UTC offset whose exact maximum gap over the 400-year Gregorian cycle is at most the operator required_frequency_hours and keeps recovery points at least 35 days (Lifecycle.DeleteAfterDays >= 35 or no expiry); FAIL when every rule is proven to miss the frequency or the retention, or the plan has no rules; UNKNOWN when no rule is proven to qualify and any rule cannot be bounded (rate(), L/W/#, wrapping or year-limited cron, DST or rule-changing time zone, event-based deletion, continuous-backup coverage, denied or malformed facts), or when the operator frequency policy is missing, malformed or does not cover the scope. Configured coverage only, not observed recovery points or job success.
new_checks.title: Backup plan min frequency and min retention check
new_checks.description: Detects an AWS Backup plan in which no rule both runs at least as often as the operator-approved interval and keeps recovery points for at least 35 days, so the plan cannot meet the backup frequency and 35-day retention objective by configuration.
new_checks.remediation_hint: Add or edit a rule in the AWS Backup plan so its schedule creates recovery points at least as often as the approved interval and its lifecycle keeps them 35 days or longer, and declare that interval as scan policy.
